fit_note: Data engine mixes URL-seeded task proposal, exploration-refined tasks, multi-agent solving and LLM-verifier filtering for SFT.
Planner writes sub-task, LLM-generated scoring program ranks DOM elements, grounder picks from top-20 shortlist.
RL-trained Coordinator plans atomic instructions and State Tracker summarises progress for a frozen Executor.
Fuses high-resolution crop features into low-res Q-Former tokens via affine renormalisation instead of extra LLM tokens.
Training-time history compression in offline GRPO: drop past screenshots, keep action anchors, align with full-history branch.
Iterative full-screen regrounding with the previous guess drawn as a marker, chaining different MLLMs; no zoom.
Synthetic screen-graph simulator used to compare SFT, single-turn RL and sparse-reward multi-turn RL for navigation.
Application wrapper on Browser-Use with DOM-marked element actions; contribution is a legal-domain use case.
Training-free pre-zoom agreement test then multi-step shrink-and-reground with minimum crop size stopping.
Attention-guided enlarged crops are each re-grounded and the densest coordinate cluster is chosen.
